280-1479-8293.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-1879-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1879-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6719-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6719-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3025-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

574-1981-2415-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
574-1981-2415-4446.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-4446.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7156.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1982-2092-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Sidisi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sidisi enters, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Sidisi, untapping the basic Swamp.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Sidisi's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

997-3249-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
997-3249-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

2081-4477-5231-7182.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Greenwarden of Murasa token, adding {R}.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 5 once.
Resolve the evoke trigger from step 7, doing nothing.
Repeat from step 6.

1988-2981-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-2981-3490-7426.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat

423-433-1437-5621--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1437-5621--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3536-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3536-5078-7328.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-6968-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-6968-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

579-1491-2113-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
579-1491-2113-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1497-1636-2532.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
1497-1636-2532.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Wild Cantor with haste.
When the Wild Cantor token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate the Wild Cantor token by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1661-4871-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-4871-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1496-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1496-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

4050-4186-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
4050-4186-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

2161-3693-4613.description:
Activate Scion of the Swarm by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

67-2438-4681.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 2.
Repeat.

3240-5147-6462-6560.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

851-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
851-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating two 2/2 Zombie Druid creature tokens.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2292-3693-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-2292-3693-5544-6431.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

1491-4029-4289-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-4029-4289-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-4029-4289-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

238-1365-1477-4050.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-1365-1477-4050.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

439-2178-5256-5615.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to The Master.
The Master does not have summoning sickness.
439-2178-5256-5615.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign
When Arashin Sovereign dies, its first ability and The Master trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Master trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill Arashin Sovereign from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting Arashin Sovereign from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1686-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kolaghan Stormsinger, adding {R}.
When Kolaghan Stormsinger dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Kolaghan Stormsinger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Kolaghan Stormsinger's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kolaghan Stormsinger triggers, giving a creature you control haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

859-1013.notablePrerequisites:
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Lurking Roper.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1013.description:
Give Lurking Roper lifelink, if needed.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2836-4059.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2836-4059.description:
Cast Dance with Calamity by paying {7}{R}, exiling your library.
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

422-2406-3718-3807.notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Stormchaser Drake.
422-2406-3718-3807.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, causing you to draw  a card.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy Stormchaser Drake and creating a copy of Chain of Acid targeting Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

839-1430-2105-4068-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five modified creatures.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
839-1430-2105-4068-5256.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Combat Celebrant.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, causing target player to mill cards equal to Combat Celebrant's power.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Mirror Image and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Mirror Image as it attacks.
Mirror Image triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Mirror Image, causing target player to mill cards equal to Mirror Image's power.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4195.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
3490-4050-4195.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any artifact creature you control, adding {1}.
Ich-Tekik triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and each Golem you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the remaining Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

430-1061-2183.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
Dreampod Druid is enchanted.
430-1061-2183.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Dreampod Druid triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

3263-4028-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Zhur-Taa Druid.
Zhur-Taa Druid does not have summoning sickness.
3263-4028-4222.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real for {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.
